name: Ulidian
text: Ulidian is the adjectival form of the names Ulaid and Ulster. The dictionary prints the head as a single line. The record of the people sits under the Ulaid node. The record of the province sits under the Ulster node. The Ulidian capital at Emain Macha anchors both records.
